name: Grupo SATA
note: Azores airline group (Azores Airlines, SATA Air Acores). Became a public company in 1980 with 50% of shares held by the Regional Government of the Azores and the remainder by TAP Air Portugal (per pt.wikipedia SATA Air Acores / Grupo SATA); the government of the Azores remains the controlling public owner. Opened https://www.azoresairlines.pt/en/corporate and corporate-governance/investors pages - they link governance documents but do not print current percentages, so the 50% figure is from the Portuguese Wikipedia history section.
